name: customer-support
description: Customer support assistant: read-only lookup of tickets and knowledge, with human approval required for any customer-visible action.

tools.name: ticket_lookup
tools.description: Read customer tickets from the support desk (read-only).

tools.name: support_knowledge
tools.description: Search the support knowledge base for resolution guidance.

notes: Ticket data is customer data — keep region_constraint aligned with the deployment region.
No reply/update actions are granted: customer-visible writes require a separate approved tool.
